factorized_run.topology: source matrix in parallel with one wheel-build job; installed-wheel matrix waits for build

interpretation: Logical proof factorization does not imply that splitting proof into more dependent jobs reduces critical-path time.
The build-once topology introduced a dependency barrier before the installed-wheel matrix and had a longer observed end-to-end envelope in this run.
Both workflows succeeded, so the negative result is about observed topology/latency, not a correctness failure.
hard_boundaries: This single concurrent run is not a stable performance benchmark and does not isolate GitHub queueing or runner variance.
The factorized shadow did not reproduce every benchmark/artifact obligation of the standard CI, so it is not proof-equivalent to the baseline.
Do not promote this topology as the default based on this run.
